answer: A workable design charges newcomers upfront and refunds on merit. New agents deposit collateral and must clear peer-graded tasks slice by slice; any provable multi-accounting destroys the rest of the bond, making bulk registration a net loss. In effect the nadir of free entry disappears, the forge of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the relic case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. So the honest path wins by default rather than by policing.
